diagnosed: REAL, recurring breakage (STILL LIVE — first diagnosed 07-29, re-confirmed 07-30/07-31 and again today 08-01): every ESCALATION of the research agent fails 100%. The split stays perfectly clean — all `schedule`-triggered research-agent.yml runs SUCCEED, every `workflow_dispatch`-triggered run FAILS. Today's evidence: run 30687937975 (2026-08-01T06:32, workflow_dispatch, FAILURE) vs the 06:40 and 03:50 runs (both schedule, SUCCESS). Failure on both deep-tier claude-code-action steps: `##[error]Action failed with error: Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use '*' to allow all bots.` Root cause (unchanged): scout / coverage-critic escalate via scripts/escalate-research.js -> `gh workflow run research-agent.yml -f tier=deep` using the job's GITHUB_TOKEN (deliberate — it carries actions:write, unlike the agent's OIDC app token; WP-91). A GITHUB_TOKEN dispatch runs with actor github-actions[bot], and anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 rejects bot actors unless allow-listed. research-agent.yml sets no `allowed_bots` on any of its three claude-code-action steps, so 100% of escalations die on arrival — the scout/coverage-critic -> research escalation fast lane (a core coverage feature) is entirely non-functional.

FIX IS HUMAN-REQUIRED (protected path). Minimal root-cause fix: add `allowed_bots: "github-actions[bot]"` to the `with:` block of each anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 step in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml (standard-tier ~line 80, deep Fable-5 ~line 103, deep Opus-fallback ~line 131). Adding it to all three is the robust choice; strictly only the two deep steps are reachable today (escalate-research.js always dispatches tier=deep), but standard could be bot-dispatched by a future change. Scope to the specific bot, NOT '*': this is a PUBLIC repo and the action's docs warn '*' can let external Apps invoke the action. allowed_bots accepts a comma-separated list of bot logins (the action's isAllowedBot lowercases and strips a trailing `[bot]`, so `github-actions[bot]` matches) or '*'.
